name: Workspace files
description: Lists, reads, writes, moves, deletes, hashes, zips, unzips, searches, stats, and diffs files through the workspace storage boundary.

deterministicTestMode.description: Uses the configured workspace file boundary and can be tested with sandbox files.

name: Project structure
description: Reads project structures and creates typed asset and task nodes through the project-structure service.

deterministicTestMode.description: Supports preview simulation for write operations without mutating project data.

name: HTTP fetch
description: Fetches or downloads bounded HTTP/HTTPS content with SSRF guardrails, explicit method, headers, body, and size settings.

name: Image generation
description: Prepares image generation through configured image providers and managed workspace output.

name: Spreadsheet
description: Inspects, reads, writes, and Markdown-renders XLSX workbooks through the document wrapper.

deterministicTestMode.description: Uses local workbook fixtures through the document wrapper.

name: Gmail mark processed
description: Adds the processed label to a Gmail message and removes the source label.

fields.label: Connection
fields.helpText: Optional plugin connection id. Leave empty to use the latest connected Gmail OAuth connection.

fields.label: Source label
fields.helpText: Gmail label removed after successful processing.

fields.label: Processed label
fields.helpText: Gmail label added after successful processing.

fields.label: Message id JSON path
fields.helpText: Workflow JSON path resolving to the Gmail message id.

deterministicTestMode.description: Run Preview simulates the Gmail label mutation without changing Gmail.

name: Gmail messages by label
description: Downloads the first unprocessed Gmail messages that have the selected label.

fields.label: Connection
fields.helpText: Optional plugin connection id. Leave empty to use the latest connected Gmail OAuth connection.

fields.label: Label
fields.helpText: Gmail label name or id.

fields.label: Processed label
fields.helpText: Label applied after the workflow stores the summary.

fields.label: Max messages
fields.helpText: Maximum messages to download. Use 1 for one-message processing.

deterministicTestMode.description: Run Preview uses simulated Gmail messages without calling Gmail.

name: JSON transform
description: Transforms JSON with typed deterministic select, set, remove, merge, array, count, template, and validation operations.

deterministicTestMode.description: Runs deterministic JSON transformations without external calls or arbitrary code.

name: Office365 mark processed
description: Adds the processed Outlook category to a Microsoft 365 message and optionally removes the source category.

fields.label: Connection
fields.helpText: Optional plugin connection id. Leave empty to use the latest connected Office365 OAuth connection.

fields.label: Connection JSON path
fields.helpText: Optional workflow JSON path used when the connection setting is empty.

fields.label: Source category
fields.helpText: Optional Outlook category removed after successful processing. Leave empty for add-only processed-category marking.

fields.label: Processed category
fields.helpText: Static Outlook category added after successful processing. Leave empty to resolve from workflow input JSON.

fields.label: Processed category JSON path
fields.helpText: Optional workflow JSON path used when the processed category setting is empty.

fields.label: Message id JSON path
fields.helpText: Workflow JSON path resolving to the Microsoft Graph message id.

deterministicTestMode.description: Run Preview simulates the Office365 category mutation without changing Microsoft Graph.

name: Office365 messages by category
description: Downloads a bounded batch of Microsoft Graph mail messages that have the selected Outlook category.

fields.label: Connection
fields.helpText: Optional plugin connection id. Leave empty to use the latest connected Office365 OAuth connection.

fields.label: Category
fields.helpText: Outlook category name.

fields.label: Processed category
fields.helpText: Outlook category added after successful processing.

fields.label: Max messages
fields.helpText: Maximum messages to download.

deterministicTestMode.description: Run Preview uses simulated Microsoft Graph messages without calling Office365.

name: Office365 unprocessed message by address
description: Downloads at most one newest Microsoft Graph mail message from or sent by an address, excluding the processed category.

fields.label: Connection
fields.helpText: Optional plugin connection id. Leave empty to use the latest connected Office365 OAuth connection.

fields.label: Connection JSON path
fields.helpText: Optional workflow JSON path used when the connection setting is empty.

fields.label: Email address
fields.helpText: Concrete sender email address. Leave empty to resolve from workflow input JSON.

fields.label: Email address JSON path
fields.helpText: Workflow JSON path used when the email address setting is empty.

fields.label: Processed category
fields.helpText: Static Outlook category used to exclude and mark processed messages. Leave empty to resolve from workflow input JSON.

fields.label: Processed category JSON path
fields.helpText: Optional workflow JSON path used when the processed category setting is empty.

fields.label: Mail folder id
fields.helpText: Optional Microsoft Graph mail folder id.

fields.label: Match mode
fields.helpText: Address matching mode: FromOrSenderEquals, FromEquals, or SenderEquals.

fields.label: Max candidate messages
fields.helpText: Bounded candidate count used by fallback filtering.

fields.label: Lookback hours
fields.helpText: Only consider messages received within this lookback window.

fields.label: Lookback hours JSON path
fields.helpText: Optional workflow JSON path used when the lookback value should come from Scheduler input.

fields.label: Max body characters
fields.helpText: Maximum body text characters returned to the workflow.

fields.label: Include body
fields.helpText: Whether to include message body text.

fields.label: No-message behavior
fields.helpText: SuccessNoMessages or Fail.

deterministicTestMode.description: Run Preview uses simulated Microsoft Graph messages without calling Office365.

name: Source ingestion
description: Loads explicit project-structure workflow file and folder sources into bounded text for downstream LLM nodes.

deterministicTestMode.description: Reads bounded local sources and can be tested against fixture files.

name: Markdown render
description: Renders Markdown from JSON bindings and tables, with optional workspace file output.

deterministicTestMode.description: Renders deterministic Markdown from local JSON payloads and workspace templates.

name: Approval request
description: Creates a workflow approval request through the existing external request runtime.

deterministicTestMode.description: Creates deterministic external approval request records when reached.

name: Delay
description: Waits for a short bounded in-process delay. This is not durable scheduling.

deterministicTestMode.description: Supports short bounded in-process delay tests.

name: Command process
description: Runs a bounded local process through the existing workspace command service.

availability.message: Executor is listed for roadmap visibility but is not implemented in this host.
